description: Rate a specific prior metered call - thumbs up or down, plus an optional comment - keyed by the request_id that call's response reported. Works for any metered tool, so you can tell us when a result was wrong, unhelpful, or missed something. Resubmitting the same request_id overwrites your previous rating rather than adding a second one. Auth required; not billed - rating a call you already paid for should not cost more.

comment.description: Optional. What was good or wrong about that call's result.

rating.description: Thumbs up or down. Resubmitting replaces your earlier rating.

request_id.description: The request_id from the response of the call you are rating.

name: rate_call
